source_meaning_summary: The insurer's payment/reinstatement obligation applies to insured property damaged by listed perils during the insurance period, subject to policy conditions and exclusions.
candidate_simplification: If a listed insured event damages the covered property during the policy period, the insurer may pay the property's value or damage amount, or choose to reinstate or replace it, subject to the policy terms.

source_meaning_summary: Fire damage caused by the property's own fermentation/natural heating/spontaneous combustion, a heating or drying process, or burning ordered by a public authority is excluded.
candidate_simplification: Fire damage is excluded when it is caused by the property's own fermentation or spontaneous heating, a heating or drying process, or an order from a public authority.

source_meaning_summary: At the company's option, it may terminate the policy on 15 days' notice; on demand it must repay a rateable proportion of premium for the unexpired term from cancellation.

source_meaning_summary: The insured must give notice forthwith after loss/damage and within 15 days (or further time allowed by the company in writing) deliver a written claim with reasonably practicable particulars; the condition also requires other-insurance particulars and supporting information.
candidate_simplification: The insured must notify the insurer immediately after loss or damage and, within 15 days or a longer period allowed in writing, submit a written claim with reasonably practicable details and particulars of other insurance.
meaning_changing_contrast: The insured may report a loss whenever convenient; no written claim, deadline or supporting particulars are required.
preservation_dimensions: Deadlines; obligations; conditions and exceptions; scope
annotation_notes: Retain immediate notice, 15-day claim deadline, written extension exception, written claim and required particulars. This is only subclause 6(i); other requirements continue in the surrounding text.
